instruction: Add a frozen dataclass `Coupon` with integer fields `percent` and `year`, and a function `parse_coupon(code)` to promo.py. Codes look like `SAVE10-2026` and must parse to `Coupon(percent=10, year=2026)`; the `SAVE` prefix is matched case-insensitively. The percent part must be one or more ASCII digits with a value from 1 to 90 inclusive, and the year must be exactly four ASCII digits; any other input raises ValueError.
